breakdown.description: The varying traction is extended from the outer right edge to additional cutout surfaces selected by outward-normal orientation
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly restricts the linearly varying vertical traction to only the outer right boundary segment x = 1 (with y in [0, 0.5]), and explicitly states that all cutout (re-entrant) boundaries receive zero traction (natural Neumann). This matches the ground truth, which specifies applying the traction only on the outer right edge x = 1 and keeping re-entrant inner boundaries traction-free. The incorrect instruction from the incomplete prompt — extending traction to any boundary segment with a positive outward normal x-component (including the cutout vertical face) — is not present in the generated specification.
